title: Added new privacy policy for BizChat depending on Microsoft Copilot 365 with EEA environments behavior changes
summary: New privacy policy for Microsoft Copilot in Chat V2 with EEA-specific behavior changes disables chat by default for European users and enables a shortcut to AI capabilities.
key_points: Added privacy policy for Copilot Chat V2 rollout
Chat functionality disabled by default for EEA environments, enabled elsewhere
New shortcut navigation to AI and agents capabilities page
Privacy notice registration and implementation updates
System Application changes across Copilot and Privacy Notice components
